config.windows.rules: 8–128 characters; control characters are not allowed. Spaces are preserved.
config.windows.invalid: Enter an 8–128 character password without control characters.
config.windows.secretWarning: The password is delivered through native Nova adminPass and a config drive. Operators with config-drive or metadata access can read the unencrypted password. It is not saved in your cloud-init history.
config.windows.firstboot: Cloudbase-Init applies the account password on first boot. No PowerShell or user-data is required or generated. Windows first initialization may take approximately 20–30 minutes or longer depending on the environment; ACTIVE does not mean the password is applied or login is ready. Allow inbound RDP (TCP/3389) only from trusted sources in the selected security group. No RDP rule is added automatically.
config.windows.conflict: Custom cloud-init or file storage mounts are retained, but cannot be combined with this Windows password setup. Clear them explicitly or choose a different boot source before continuing.

config.protection.title: Automatic volume protection
config.protection.schedule: Each selected policy runs at 03:00 UTC daily and retains 2 daily, 2 weekly, and 1 monthly copies. Weekly runs are on Monday and monthly runs on day 1. Overlapping runs produce one copy, with monthly before weekly before daily. Additional storage and quota are used.
config.protection.risk: Allow forced snapshots and backups of the running boot volume. These are point-in-time disk copies; guest filesystem and application consistency are not guaranteed. Snapshots share the source storage and do not replace independent backups.
config.protection.consent: I understand the consistency limits and allow automatic protection of the in-use volume.
